commencement_date.quote: the Term (as defined in the Lease) commenced on September 1, 2000
commencement_date.note: The original lease defined the date as the earlier of occupancy or July 1, 2000 (subject to delivery). The First Amendment recital confirms the actual commencement of Sept 1, 2000.

expiration_date.quote: The Term of the Lease is hereby extended until February 28, 2011.
expiration_date.note: Overrides the original 60-month term, the First Amendment expiration (Aug 31, 2005, later stated as Dec 31, 2005), and Second Amendment extension is the operative term. Excludes the 5-year option.

initial_monthly_base_rent.value: $21,872.92 per month for the original premises (Lease Months 1-60)
initial_monthly_base_rent.note: First-period rent for the original 10,499 RSF only. Later amendments added rent for the other premises and restructured it; from Jan 1, 2004 total monthly Basic Rent is $51,241.46.

rent_escalation.value: Original lease: flat $21,872.92/month for 60 months. First Amendment: stepped rent for the first-floor space. Second Amendment (operative from Jan 1, 2004): stepped annual schedule of about 3% per year, from $51,241.46/month in 2004 to $63,020.53/month for Jan-Feb 2011. No Basic Rent accrues Jan 1 - Feb 28, 2006.
rent_escalation.normalised: Stepped annual increases of about 3%: $51,241.46/mo (2004) rising to $63,020.53/mo (Jan-Feb 2011); Jan-Feb 2006 abated
rent_escalation.quote: (ii) for the period from January 1, 2005, through December 31, 2005: $633,344.43 per annum ($52,778.70 per month);
rent_escalation.note: Percentage is my calculation from the stated schedule (e.g. 52,778.70/51,241.46). Second Amendment also resets the Expense Stop to calendar year 2004 and the Base Tax Year to 2004, so operating expense and tax pass-throughs apply above those bases.

renewal_option.value: One (1) five-year extension option (Option Term). Rent is the greater of $756,246.36 per annum or fair market rent, with appraisal procedure if not agreed.
renewal_option.normalised: One 5-year option at greater of $756,246.36/yr or FMV
renewal_option.quote: The Tenant may elect to extend the term of the Lease for one (1) five (5) year period (the "Option Term")
renewal_option.note: Granted by Second Amendment §4. The lease's Exhibit H (Renewal Option) is listed but not included in the text provided; the Second Amendment is treated as operative.
renewal_option.flag: value not visible in quote (derived or calculated)

renewal_notice_months.value: 9 months (notice window: not earlier than 12 months nor later than 9 months before expiration of the Restructure Term)
renewal_notice_months.quote: not earlier than twelve (12) months nor later than nine (9) months before the expiration of the Restructure Term
renewal_notice_months.note: Latest notice date is 9 months before expiration; the tenant must also not be in default.

early_termination.value: None. The lease grants no tenant right to terminate early for convenience. The tenant can terminate only after a qualifying partial condemnation or a major casualty (Sections 14(b) and 15(b)).
early_termination.normalised: No voluntary early termination right; only condemnation/casualty termination rights
early_termination.quote: then Tenant may terminate this Lease as of the date of such Taking by giving written notice to Landlord within 30 days after the Taking
early_termination.note: No termination option or fee found in the lease or amendments. The quote is the condemnation termination right, the only termination right of this kind.

security_deposit.value: $614,897.50 under the Second Amendment, subject to conditions (net worth of at least $15,000,000 and cash balance of $5,500,000 through Dec 31, 2005). If the conditions fail, the deposit goes back to $793,039.00. Further scheduled reductions to $489,258.56, $346,036.28 and $183,554.94. The original lease required $262,475.04 plus a $291,199.96 Additional Security Deposit.
security_deposit.quote: Subject to the following conditions, on the Effective Date the Security Deposit shall be reduced to $614,897.50.
security_deposit.note: The deposit was $262,475.04 at signing (plus $291,199.96 additional, totalling $553,675.00). The First Amendment raised it to $793,039.00. The Second Amendment reduces it to $614,897.50 on an 'Effective Date' that is not defined, so the figure is conditional and ambiguous.
